verdict.rationale: Kit's API exposes broadcast-level engagement stats (opens, clicks, unsubscribes) aggregated across recipients (kit-docs-36, kit-docs-37) and per-link click counts, but there is no documented endpoint returning a per-contact history of what was sent to that specific subscriber and whether they opened/clicked it. The evidence pack shows no subscriber-level activity/timeline endpoint, so the specific 'per-person engagement history for any contact' capability is unevidenced.
